summary: Locked competitive-exam formats + batched generation tested end-to-end. Backend 4/5 pytest pass: /formats returns all 5 presets (JEE_MAINS 75/180/300, JEE_ADV 54/180/180, CAT 66/120/198, UPSC 100/120/200, NEET 180/200/720) with all required fields including format_distribution, batch_size, subjects, notes. JEE_MAINS generate with client-sent question_count=5/duration_minutes=10 was correctly overridden — paper persisted with duration_minutes=180, total_marks=300, format_distribution={mcq:80,numerical:20}. Background batched generation completed in ~135s and yielded 75 questions (verified <=75 truncation cap and >=60 variance floor). PDF download on the freshly-generated competitive paper returns 200 application/pdf. GENERIC exam respects client values (5q/25min persisted as-is). Frontend E2E verified: on the seeded JEE_MAINS preset (d684ab45) the locked-format-card renders with 'JEE Main 2026 — NTA pattern' label, locked-questions=75, locked-duration=180, locked-marks=300, NTA notes paragraph; comp-question-count and comp-duration inputs are HIDDEN; difficulty + custom-prompt + comp-generate-btn still render. GENERIC exam (51675e77…) correctly renders the question_count/duration inputs and no locked card.

minor.issue: Spec says 'Endpoint is auth-protected' but the route in competitive_routes.py has NO Depends(get_current_user). Unauthenticated request returns 200 with the full formats dict. Either remove the spec line or add Depends(get_current_user) to the handler. Frontend already sends Authorization header so behaviour is unchanged in-app, but the contract claim is violated.

Either (a) add `user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)` to the handler to match the spec line, OR (b) update the spec to acknowledge the endpoint is public (the dict is non-sensitive canonical data). critical_code_review_comments: _generate_competitive_paper batching logic is correct: num_batches=ceil(total_q/batch_size), sizes distributed evenly with leftover spread by `for i in range(total_q - sum(sizes)): sizes[i]+=1`. For JEE_MAINS that's [25,25,25] — clean. Per-batch failure tolerance via try/except + continue is sound, and the final-fail path raises only if ALL batches yielded zero. Good.

competitive_routes.py line 472: `total_marks: spec['total_marks'] if spec else req.question_count` — uses question_count as marks fallback for GENERIC. Slightly counter-intuitive (1 mark per Q assumption); a comment helps but maybe rename to make explicit. The /generate-paper handler (line 503) also does this, kept consistent.
exam_formats.py is well-structured and immutable (module-level dict), single source of truth for both backend lock + frontend display via /formats endpoint. No drift risk now.

Lock is applied in two places: paper_doc creation (immediate persistence at line 497-520) AND the post-generation update_one (line 459-477). Both reach for spec independently — consider extracting into a small helper to avoid future drift. Not blocking.
/formats endpoint is unauthenticated (no Depends in route) — minor contract gap with spec. Trivial 1-line fix.
